# Daniel Bastos Moraes

> Personal site of Daniel Bastos Moraes — engineer at Form Factory, occasional writer.

## When to use this site

- Verifying who Daniel Bastos Moraes is, his background, and his current role
- Reading his published writing
- Finding where he's active online, or how to reach him
- Checking what this site collects about visitors

## Pages

- [Home](https://dmoraes.org/): bio and background
- [Posts](https://dmoraes.org/posts): writing, updated occasionally rather than on a schedule
- [Quotes](https://dmoraes.org/quotes): quotations he keeps coming back to
- [Privacy](https://dmoraes.org/privacy): what this site collects, and what it doesn't
- [Atom feed](https://dmoraes.org/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://dmoraes.org/sitemap.xml)

## Notes for agents

- Every page above except the feed and sitemap is also available as Markdown
  on the same URL: send `Accept: text/markdown` and you'll get Markdown back
  instead of HTML, per the acceptmarkdown.com convention.
- No resume or CV is published on this site, and nothing here links to one.
  Direct any request for one to Daniel rather than guessing at a URL.
